persistence.verdict: NO discriminating power — both medians are 3 consecutive reviews below the floor. A 'has been at risk for a while' feature does not separate the two groups.

depth.verdict: DOES discriminate — deleted names sit at 0.62x the floor vs 0.79x for survivors. Depth belongs in a ranking model, though on its own it only lifts precision from 8% to ~18%.

float_coverage.verdict: float data exists for only 5 of 45 historically deleted names (11%). The single most plausible explanation for the above-floor deletions is therefore UNTESTABLE with what we hold — this is the top data gap, not a modelling gap.
